title: dependencies.py MODIFY — 2 new DI factories
summary: Implementation is a purely additive 2-import + 2-factory append. All 10 existing factories (supplier/staff/dealer/grade/design/design_grade_map/inward/sales/adjustment/design_grade_cb) are byte-identical to their S1+S2 form. The two new imports (DashboardService, SalesReportService) sit in alphabetical position within the src.application.services.* block. The two new factories follow the exact established pattern `def get_<noun>_service(db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> <Noun>Service: return <Noun>Service(db)`. Both target services accept a Session positionally in their __init__, so DI resolution will bind correctly. No security surface (DI plumbing only). Contract matches LLD files[8] exactly: exports {get_dashboard_service, get_sales_report_service}, depends_on {session.py, dashboard_service.py, sales_report_service.py}. No findings.
